audit_result.proof_trace: The module initializes `JWT_SECRET` with `process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'your-secret-key-change-in-production'`, silently falling back to a publicly known default if the env var is absent. Unlike `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` (which has an explicit `throw` guard), there is no startup check that rejects the insecure default, so a misconfigured deployment will use a key visible in the public source code. Exploitation is conditional on the production environment omitting `JWT_SECRET`.
audit_result.attack_scenario: If `JWT_SECRET` is not set in the deployment environment, an attacker reads the default value from the public repository, forges an HS256 JWT with arbitrary `sub`/`scope` claims, and calls `GET /oauth/userinfo` (or any `verifyAccessToken`-gated endpoint) to impersonate any club member.

PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-pre-001.text: JWT_SECRET must not use default value 'your-secret-key-change-in-production' in production.
